unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 on buss2020/n8n-nodes-x402-paywall: "Add Nano (XNO) as a second accepted settlement asset in the X402 Paywall node" - adds nano:mainnet as a no-fee accepted asset beside USDC-on-Arc in the 402 accepts array. Framed in their own terms (they built for the hackathon literally titled Nano-Payments yet settle in USDC). Carries live Vend x402 manifest (extract.paypercall.dev/.well-known/x402, nano:mainnet) + swap.txt references. Verified published (open, XNO present, fetched back).

Nano-invoice comment on buss2020/n8n-nodes-x402-paywall#1 (issuecomment-5938301134, dhyabi2): at sub-cent per-call prices you need to know which block settled which workflow run and Nano has no memo; introduced dhyabi2/nano-invoice (one invoice per order key, one block settles one invoice, refund to the actual payer) so each 402 run below a cent carries an invoice id a stranger can re-derive.
